subject: english
question: Convert to direct speech:The scientist stated that water boiled at 100°C.

options.text: “Water will boil at 100°C,” said the scientist.
“Water had boiled at 100°C,” said the scientist.
“Water is boiling at 100°C,” said the scientist.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The scientist stated that water boiled at 100°C.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "stated" is used after the quoted speech.
